objects.description: During the investigation of [Operation Sharpshooter](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0013), security researchers identified [Rising Sun](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0448) in 87 organizations across the globe and subsequently discovered three variants.(Citation: McAfee Sharpshooter December 2018)(Citation: Bleeping Computer Op Sharpshooter March 2019)
objects.description_fa: در طول بررسی [عملیات شارپ شوتر](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0013)، محققان امنیتی [Rising Sun](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0448) را در ۸۷ سازمان در سراسر جهان شناسایی کردند و متعاقباً سه نوع آن را کشف کردند. (Citation: McAfee Sharpshooter December 2018) (Citation: Bleeping Computer Op Sharpshooter March 2019)
